purpose: Machine-readable provenance index mapping incident ids and reports to raw transcripts, evidence files, contract snapshots, relevant dates, and evidence type. validation_rules.every_report_indexed: Every file in 01 Reports with .md or .txt extension must appear as report_path in entries
validation_rules.every_indexed_path_exists: Every report_path, raw_transcript, evidence_file, contract_snapshot, and orphan path must exist on disk
validation_rules.duplicate_incident_ids: incident_id values that are non-null must be unique
validation_rules.duplicate_marking: Files under 99 Duplicate Archive must be marked with duplicate_status superseded or duplicate and must not appear as canonical
validation_rules.no_credentials: No indexed path may reference credential-bearing material (.env, tailscale installer, share-check HTML dump) and no file content is scanned here — validator checks path denylist
